# Palworld Mods

> Focused tools, regional rules, and cloud operations for dedicated Palworld servers.

## Overview

Palworld Mods is an unofficial fan-made project created by Skick providing tools for Palworld dedicated server operators:

- **PalLaw (Offline)**: Standalone, offline C++ UE4SS mod and browser Rules Studio for regional combat laws and safe zones configured via local `PalLaw.json`.
- **PalOrbit (Cloud Platform)**: Cloud-hosted SaaS platform and native C++ UE4SS mod (`PalOrbit.dll`) featuring Cloud Zone Studio, live map telemetry, Discord Cross-Chat Relay, role-based privileges, and web starter kit claims.
- **Rules Studio**: Static web tool for visual polygon authoring and PalLaw JSON configuration validation. Runs entirely in the client browser with zero server upload.

## Products

### PalLaw (Offline Standalone Mod)
- **Website & Editor**: https://palworld.skick.xyz/pallaw/
- **Nexus Mods Download**: https://www.nexusmods.com/palworld/mods/4193
- **Primary Function**: Regional player-vs-player and combat restrictions. Does not enable damage on globally PvE servers; restricts combat inside defined polygon regions on PvP servers.
- **Storage & Telemetry**: 100% offline. No analytics, no telemetry, no tracking.

### PalOrbit (Cloud Platform)
- **Web App**: https://palorbit.app
- **Primary Function**: Unified server operations with Cloud Zone Studio, live player map telemetry, bi-directional Discord Cross-Chat Relay, and web-based kit fulfillment.
- **Architecture**: Outbound encrypted TLS connection from `PalOrbit.dll` to the PalOrbit Cloud Gateway. Zero inbound ports required.
